brief: Add a `currency` argument (an ISO code, default "USD") to format_price in pricing/money.py. It must use the symbol from SYMBOLS in pricing/symbols.py and the number of decimals from DECIMALS there (2 for a currency DECIMALS doesn't list), so format_price(1234, "EUR") is "€12.34" and format_price(1234, "JPY") is "¥1234". Then make Invoice.total_line in billing/invoice.py and summary_line in reports/summary.py format in their own currency. Output in USD must not change.
